# MeeeShop - US Women's Fashion & Apparel

> MeeeShop (us.meeeshop.com) is an online women's fashion boutique offering trendy dresses, tops, bottoms, outerwear, boho clothing, and accessories with free US shipping and a 7-day return policy.

## Store Overview
- **Website**: https://us.meeeshop.com
- **Target Audience**: Women in the USA
- **Shipping**: Free US Shipping on eligible orders
- **Return Policy**: 7-Day Return Policy
